The program error is the word "input" inside comments, which trips the forbidden-construct check. I removed every instance. I also raised the initial tail current to 55 µA so the gain-bandwidth sits closer to the 300 MHz target. The topology (5-transistor OTA with resistive inverting feedback, β≈0.993) is otherwise unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "itail": (55e-6, 30e-6, 62e-6),   # tail current (set by mirror W ratio vs IREF)
    "Wt":    (16.0, 6.0, 40.0),       # tail W [um]
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # tail / bias-diode L
    "Win":   (12.0, 4.0, 30.0),       # diff pair W each
    "Lin":   (0.4, 0.3, 1.0),         # diff pair L
    "Wp":    (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),        # PMOS mirror W each
    "Lp":    (0.35, 0.18, 0.6),       # PMOS mirror L (short -> fast mirror pole)
    "R1":    (500e3, 100e3, 1e6),     # source-side resistor
    "trim":  (1.0, 0.97, 1.03),       # trim on Rf/R1
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 200e-15)

    # power budget clamp (8% margin)
    itail = min(p["itail"], 140e-6 / vdd * 0.92 - iref)
    itail = max(itail, 5e-6)

    def vgs_for(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.1, 1.8
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    # PMOS diode-load bias
    Wp, Lp = p["Wp"], p["Lp"]
    vsg_p = vgs_for('p', Wp, Lp, itail / 2, 0.9)
    vd1 = vdd - vsg_p

    # diff pair bias: iterate on the tail node
    Win, Lin = p["Win"], p["Lin"]
    vs = 0.15
    vgs_in = 0.75
    for _ in range(4):
        vgs_in = vgs_for('n', Win, Lin, itail / 2, max(vcm - vs, 0.05), vs)
        vs = vcm - vgs_in
    opn = lut.op('n', Win, Lin, vgs_in, max(vcm - vs, 0.05), max(vs, 0.0))
    opp = lut.op('p', Wp, Lp, vsg_p, vdd - vcm)

    # tail / bias diode (mirror by W ratio, same L)
    Wt, Lt = p["Wt"], p["Lt"]
    Wb = max(0.42, Wt * iref / itail)
    vgs_b = vgs_for('n', Wb, Lt, iref, 0.6)

    # small-signal predictions
    gm = opn["gm"]
    A = gm / (opn["gds"] + opp["gds"])
    ratio0 = 0.007
    R1 = p["R1"]
    beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio0)
    ratio = ratio0 * (1 + 1.0 / (A * beta)) * p["trim"]
    Rf = ratio * R1
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    a1 = -ratio * A * beta / (1 + A * beta)
    cpar = 0.35 * (opn["cgg"] + opp["cgg"]) + 0.5 * opn["cgg"]
    ugb = gm / (2 * PI * (cl + cpar))
    bw = ugb * beta
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, Lt)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lt)
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, Lin)    # non-inverting side
    n.M("M2", "vout", "vn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, Lin)   # inverting side
    n.M("MP1", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("MP2", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1)
    n.R("RF", "vn", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)   # vin2 unused: benign DC termination

    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "power": power,
               "vout_offset": 0.0, "A_ol": A, "vd1": vd1, "vtail": vs,
               "itail": itail, "gm_in": gm}
```
